name: Centred results quote with CTA
purpose: Caps a results block with a customer voice that confirms the numbers, then invites the reader to the demo.
description: Page-local block placed directly after the Results card grid inside the same container-medium wrapper: a 32px (28 tab / 24 mob) medium-weight quote in a 60rem column (centred, or left-aligned on /lms/small-business), a stacked avatar (5rem, 3rem on small-business) with the site's 6px tag corners below 1440 and round at >=1440, the name and a grey role with an optional linked org; the page then renders a centred primary button row. On /lms the same markup is the inline FinalQuote function (quote + author + button in one component). /lms/enterprise uses CentredQuote twice: after Results, and as the `after` slot of the service SplitAutotabs.

evidenceNotes:
The CTA button is not part of CentredQuote.jsx: SmallBusiness.jsx and Enterprise.jsx render it as a sibling
right after the quote; on /lms FinalQuote includes it.

/lms/enterprise has a second CentredQuote (60-word quote, role 'Digital Learning Experience Platform Manager,', org 'Northwind Roads', button 'Explore our expert services →') inside SERVICE_AFTER, rendered by SplitAutotabs' `after` slot; it sets the quote budget.
The source comment in CentredQuote.jsx says it is used 'inside the results blocks of /lms', but /lms actually uses its own inline FinalQuote copy, not CentredQuote.
align ('left' on /lms/small-business) and avatar size are layout knobs, not modelled.
